answer: No Welshbound caerphilly sorter churn licence, no seat: the rule is plain, and a licence caerphilly sorters carry after dairy room audits is why it holds. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Each name is charged £26 in fees and a 5-day delay before the stamp dries, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. One beacon, one entry. The clerk notes falcon. Every nectar is counted once.
